security_changes.owner_trigger: No in-container UID1000 wake channel. Future Owner Gate action is creation of the fresh dedicated Codespace; root ENTRYPOINT auto-start is the only reviewed trigger.
security_changes.step3: Producer once-opens and authenticates Step3 and retains that exact fd; POST_OAUTH_ONLY same-object runner uses isolated Python plus private socketpair to frozen control runner step3-preflight.
security_changes.python_build_gate: Docker build runs exact fd-bound isolated Python, imports PyNaCl 1.6.2, performs SealedBox roundtrip, enumerates sys.modules and /proc/self/maps, and requires exact manifest identity.
